podcast.title: Vaporwave's Muzak with Nostalgia (Originated 2012)
podcast.body: Mallsoft emerged in 2012 as a subgenre akin to vaporwave's version of Muzak, but imbued with a strong nostalgic element. It uses background music, such as easy listening, smooth jazz, and Muzak, typically associated with shopping malls. "El mallsoft es como el muzac del Bapur Wave, pero con un fuerte componente nostálgico. El surgió en 2012"

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Atmosphere of Commercial Spaces
podcast.body: Mallsoft is a subgenre designed to evoke the ambiance of large, bustling shopping centers, characterized by expansive spaces and nebulous atmospheres. Artists frequently incorporate field recordings from actual commercial spaces to enhance this sound, creating a dreamlike and hazy environment that often expresses nostalgia for the popular shopping malls and consumer culture of the 1980s and 1990s. "El Malsop está diseño para aparecerse al ambiente de cientos comerciales grandes y llenos de gente, con espacios enormes de atmóseras nebulosas, incorporando a veces grabaciones de campo de cientos comerciales reales para lograr aún más ese sonido."

podcast.title: Darker Tone and Liminal Spaces
podcast.body: In recent years, Mallsoft has evolved to adopt a darker tone, suggesting the solitude of empty shopping malls. This shift has contributed to the popularization of concepts like liminal spaces and backrooms within the genre's aesthetic. "En los últimos años el género ha ido adoptando un tono más oscuro, sugiriendo la soledad de los centros comerciales vacíos, deminó la popularización de los espacios liminales y los back rooms."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Recreating Commercial Atmospheres
podcast.body: Through extensive reverb and editing, Mallsoft meticulously recreates the ambiance of large commercial spaces, often integrating field recordings from these locations. This technique intensifies its dreamlike environment and evokes a sense of capitalist nostalgia, specifically recalling the consumerism prevalent in the 1980s and 1990s. "el mallsoft recrea la almohsfera de grandes espacios comerciales, a menudo incluyendo grabaciones de campo de estos lugares para intensificar su ambiente unírico y la nostálgia capitalista, evocando el consumismo de los años 80's y 90's."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Vaporwave Subgenre with Limited Reach
podcast.body: Mallsoft is identified as an "interesting" subgenre of Vaporwave whose artistic foundation did not manage to connect with the general public beyond niche communities, contributing to Vaporwave's eventual decline due to lack of adaptability to broader internet trends. "su género está en interesantes como el malls off, el utopía anvirtual o el slash wave no lograron conectar con la gente más allá de nichos."
